text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Orfevre—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking in the direction Orfevre pointed, there was a claw machine filled with plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Clasping the doll with slender mechanical claws,
carrying it precariously toward the goal without dropping it—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh, it's just like a tightrope walking act.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: Huh, I'm the one doing it?
Huh, I'm the one doing it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Consider it an honor.
After all, you are serving your king.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Fulfill your duties as a subject.
...Do not bore me.
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
